meaning.zh:
“陷入困境” 或 “遇到麻烦”。

这个短语源自航海和游泳的隐喻。在深水中，相较于浅水，情况往往更加危险，尤其对于不擅游泳的人来说。因此，“Get into deep water” 被用来形容一个人遇到了棘手的问题或陷入了复杂的困境。
meaning.en: This phrase originates from the metaphor of sailing and swimming. In deep water, situations are generally more dangerous compared to shallow water, especially for those who are not strong swimmers. Hence, "Get into deep water" is used to describe someone who has encountered a difficult problem or a complicated situation.

lines.en: He got into deep water when he couldn't pay back his debts on time.
lines.zh: 他因为无法按时偿还债务而陷入困境。

lines.en: They got into deep water by violating the company's policy.
lines.zh: 他们因违反公司政策而陷入麻烦。

lines.en: She got into deep water trying to handle the project alone.
lines.zh: 她因为试图独自处理这个项目而陷入了困境。
